description: Several young women in 1920s cloche hats and long coats stand and chat in a narrow cobbled street beside a brick building whose doorway is open and glowing. A large sign on the brick wall reads POLLING STATION. Behind them a queue of people in flat caps and hats waits, and a uniformed policeman with a helmet stands on the right next to a man in a flat cap. Gas lamps and dark tenement buildings fill the background.
reason: The painted sign on the brick wall reads POLLING STATION in large letters, and a smaller sign on the right also carries lettering. The text must be removed or repainted without words.
